_purpose: Test-only overlay of house assays that exist on the local stack but not yet in the committed assay catalog (NessieAI/chat_nextseek/src/chat_nextseek/context/assays_db.json, which is prod-true). test_map_contract.py merges these entries into the catalog it checks rules against, the way sampletype_attributes.json carries hand_edits for sample types. Never read at runtime. Delete an entry once its assay is in context/assays.json and the exports.

assays.Name: ATAC-Seq
assays.why: Owner's ruling of 2026-11-16: ATAC-seq from every source (GDC's TCGA BAMs under DNA, nf-core/atacseq results under D.SEQ) is filed as A.ATAC under ATAC-Seq, and the atacseq map's rules name it. A.ATAC exists on dev only; the catalog rows for ATAC-Seq and A.ATAC are not in context/*.json or the exports yet.
